items.title: multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills
items.summary_en: A single CLAUDE.md file introduces four principles for Claude Code to address LLM coding pitfalls: Think Before Coding, Simplicity First, Surgical Changes, and Goal-Driven Execution. The guidelines combat assumptions, overcomplication, irrelevant edits, and vague success criteria. Available as a Claude Code plugin via `/plugin marketplace add forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills`, it is part of the open-source Multica platform for managing coding agents.

items.title: DeepSeek Bot来了！民间版，DSH装个插件就能用
items.summary_en: DeepSeek Bot is a community-built multi-bot team plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), available via the npx command on both desktop and web versions. Each bot features persistent long-term memory stored in Markdown files, configurable models, and a Main Bot supervisor that reduces token costs in group chats by routing requests through a single coordinator. The open-source project (Apache 2.0) gained over 250 GitHub stars within a day and supports local data storage with usage statistics tracking.

items.title: Show HN: SwapBackdrop – reuse one cutout across video backgrounds and frames
items.summary_en: SwapBackdrop lets users remove a background from a video once, then reuse that single cutout across different backdrops and aspect ratios (9:16, 1:1, 16:9) to generate multiple MP4s from one source. It supports H.264 SDR files up to 15 seconds and charges per source upload rather than per exported MP4. The tool is designed for creators who already have authorized footage and need quick backdrop swaps without reprocessing.

items.title: Show HN: I made an agent can self-improving while working
items.summary: GEAR是一款为AI Agent提供递归自我改进（RSI）能力的工具，通过任务反馈持续优化技能、工具和流程。在Marketing 100公开任务中，Astra max结合GEAR调优harness的任务通过率从27%提升至53%，而Codex Agent仅达57%；Terminal-Bench 2.1上，Luna的通过率从52.87%跃升至84.26%。其工作模式为自动化分析失败案例、生成并评估harness改进方案，保留表现最优的版本。
items.summary_en: GEAR is a self-improving agent harness that uses recursive self-improvement (RSI) to refine skills, tools, and workflows through task feedback. In Marketing benchmarks with 100 public tasks, objective completion rose from 27% to 53%, while on Terminal-Bench 2.1, Luna's task pass rate increased from 52.87% to 84.26%, surpassing Astra max with Codex's 57% pass rate. The system optimizes by inspecting failed runs, proposing harness changes, evaluating candidates, and retaining higher-performing versions.

directions.name: SkillFlow——Karpathy式个人AI技能库

directions.description_en: A plug-and-play AI programming skill set for indie developers, enabling anyone to build their own LLM-driven workflow like Karpathy.
directions.target_user: 独立开发者和一人公司创业者，想用AI辅助编程但缺乏系统方法的人
directions.target_user_en: Indie developers and solopreneurs who want to use AI for coding but lack a systematic approach

Claude Code/GPT等主流Agent的可插拔技能加载器
一键导出和分享个人技能包到社区
core_features_en: Pluggable local skill file manager based on Karpathy skills concept
Plug-and-play skill loader for Claude Code/GPT and other major AI agents
One-click export and share personal skill packs to community
directions.why_now: GitHub Trending上multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills评分7/10入选，反映社区对Karpathy编程方法论的热议。Claude Code等AI编程工具快速普及，开发者急需将优秀提示词和技能沉淀为可复用的个人资产，而非每次从零开始。
directions.why_now_en: multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills scored 7/10 on GitHub Trending, reflecting community buzz around Karpathy's programming methodology. With AI coding tools like Claude Code rapidly adopting, developers urgently need to persist and reuse high-quality prompts and skills as personal assets instead of starting from scratch each time.
directions.monetization: 免费版+高级技能包订阅（$9/月），企业团队共享技能库

directions.name: DeepBot协同工坊——一人公司多Bot记忆中枢
directions.name_en: DeepBot Co-op Workshop - Solopreneur Multi-Bot Memory Hub
directions.description: 一款基于DeepSeek插件架构的一人公司多Bot协同工具，让不同AI角色共享持久化记忆、分工协作完成复杂项目。
directions.description_en: A solopreneur multi-Bot collaboration tool based on DeepSeek plugin architecture, enabling different AI roles to share persistent memory and cooperate on complex projects.
directions.target_user: 一人公司创始人和独立开发者，需要同时使用多个AI工具完成产品开发、运营、写作等任务
directions.target_user_en: Solopreneurs and indie developers who need to use multiple AI tools simultaneously for product development, operations, and writing tasks
core_features: 多Bot角色分工配置（产品经理Bot/开发Bot/运营Bot等）
跨会话持久化记忆共享，Bot间可传递上下文
core_features_en: Multi-Bot role configuration (Product Manager Bot / Developer Bot / Operations Bot)
Cross-session persistent memory sharing between Bots
directions.why_now: 量子位报道DeepSeek民间版插件正式上线，社区热议'一人公司'与'多Bot协同'概念。插件机制降低了技术门槛，但用户仍缺乏将多个AI角色串联起来的工具。此时推出多Bot记忆共享平台，正好填补DeepSeek生态爆发期的空白，Rumors中大量一人公司创业者在寻找能整合多种AI能力的方案。
directions.why_now_en: Quantum Bit reported the launch of DeepSeek community plugin, with community enthusiasm around 'solopreneur' and 'multi-Bot collaboration' concepts. The plugin mechanism lowered technical barriers, but users still lack tools to string multiple AI roles together. Releasing a multi-Bot memory sharing platform now fills the gap during DeepSeek's ecosystem boom, with many solopreneurs seeking solutions to integrate multiple AI capabilities according to community discussions.
directions.monetization: Freemium：3个Bot免费，Pro版$15/月解锁无限Bot和高级记忆存储
directions.monetization_en: Freemium: 3 Bots free, Pro tier $15/month unlocks unlimited Bots and advanced memory storage
